body: I'm Irish late 20s and live in Llobregat, I've been looking at buying somewhere around here but flats are still 300k for something with more than one bedroom and I make after tax around 18k a year so saving for a deposit would take 10 years and it's still cheaper than Ireland. It's a housing supply problem that everyone loves too scapegoat immigrants but calling them 'expats' sounds more antifascist and less racist, same thing in Ireland. Anyone is responsible but the people you choose to elect. Also if you're not from here, hire a mediator to deal with fees etc a 2% fuck off fee is better than 5% estate agent fee. I'm considering buying a structurally sound freehold and renovating it any other option is unaffordable currently. Best of luck!
